newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rises on crude gains, strong buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rises on crude gains, strong buying.

text.p: NWE gasoline was propelled higher on Wednesday on late gains in crude at the end of a choppy day's trading which saw Eurograde barges done at anything from $201 to $209.50 fob ARA.
Traders said that business was dominated by one player, who they estimated has picked up more than 50,000 tonnes over the last five days.

The buyer picked up some 17,000 tonnes worth of Eurograde barge material at $201.50, $201 and $202 in early trade, but traders reported the player bought Eurograde barges at prices as high as $209.50 later.
Summer grade material was assessed some $3 above winter grade.
Players attributed the gains to sharp gains in crude. April IPE Brent shot up to $19.66 after it bounced off the intra-day low of $18.90 seen on bearish U.S. crude stock data.
Some traders also speculated that the player was also seeking to protect swaps positions.
"They being bidding higher than the market all week," said one. Most players expected the material to move out of the region, with some saying it was earmarked for an Eastern destination.
A regular barge was reported done at $196 in late trade.
On the swaps, April was seen around $206 having traded at $205.25 earlier.

The cargo market was fairly quiet. A small, 6,000 tonnes wintergrade cargo was reported offered out of Denmark. Traders assessed bids and offers around $209/$210. -- London Newsroom, +$44 171 542 7714.
